# Usage, cost and insights

<!-- Generated by tools/docs/api_reference.py from contracts/openapi; do not edit. -->

Base path: `https://<gateway>/metering`. Every call needs an API key or a Studio session (see [Authentication](index.md#authentication)). Request and response fields are in the OpenAPI document, `contracts/openapi/metering.json`.

| Method | Path | What it does | Body | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/alerts` | List Alerts |  | 200 list of `AlertOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/alerts/{alert_id}/acknowledge` | Acknowledge |  | 200 `AlertOut` |
| `GET` | `/v1/budgets` | List Budgets |  | 200 list of `BudgetOut` |
| `PUT` | `/v1/budgets` | Create or change the budget for the organization or one assistant. | `BudgetIn` | 200 `BudgetOut` |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/budgets/{budget_id}` | Delete Budget |  | 204 |
| `GET` | `/v1/insights/agents` | Assistants with any recorded activity or usage. |  | 200 list of string |
| `GET` | `/v1/insights/gaps` | What people asked that the knowledge does not answer, grouped into topics (UX G3). |  | 200 `GapReport` |
| `GET` | `/v1/insights/kpis` | The pack's own KPIs (`analytics.kpis`). |  | 200 list of `Kpi` |
| `GET` | `/v1/insights/quality` | Answer rate, citations, handoffs, satisfaction and tool errors over time. |  | 200 `Quality` |
| `GET` | `/v1/usage/summary` | A month's tokens and cost, by assistant, model and profile, with a daily series. |  | 200 `UsageSummary` |
